title: Implement AI Chat API Endpoint
description: Create a protected API route that handles AI chat interactions and extracts structured schedule data
details: Create app/api/chat/route.ts using Next.js API routes. Implement session validation using Better Auth to ensure only authenticated users can access. Use Vercel AI SDK's streamText function with GPT-4 to process user messages about schedules. Implement function calling to extract structured event data (title, date, startTime, endTime, type) from natural language. Store both the chat messages and extracted events in the database using Drizzle ORM. Handle streaming responses and error cases gracefully. Include system prompts that guide the AI to act as a time management coach and provide actionable feedback on schedule optimization.
test_strategy: Mock the AI SDK responses and test data extraction logic. Verify session protection works correctly. Test database insertion of both chat messages and events. Create integration tests for the full chat flow including streaming responses.

title: Create Database Schema for Schedule Events
description: Design and implement the database schema for storing user schedule events and activities using Drizzle ORM
details: Extend the existing database schema by creating new tables for events/activities linked to users. Define the events table with columns: id (primary key), userId (foreign key to users table), title (varchar), description (text), startTime (timestamp), endTime (timestamp), date (date), type (enum: meeting, workout, focus, etc.), createdAt, updatedAt. Also create a chat_messages table to store conversation history with columns: id, userId, message (text), role (user/assistant), timestamp. Use Drizzle ORM schema definitions and generate migrations using drizzle-kit. Ensure proper indexing on userId and date columns for query performance.
test_strategy: Write unit tests to verify schema definitions are correct and migrations run successfully. Test foreign key constraints and data integrity. Verify that queries by userId and date are properly indexed.

title: Build Main Chat Interface
description: Replace the main page with an interactive chat interface using assistant-ui components
details: Completely replace app/page.tsx content with a client component that implements assistant-ui. Configure the chat interface to communicate with the /api/chat endpoint using @ai-sdk/react hooks. Implement proper message streaming, loading states, and error handling. Style the chat interface using shadcn/ui components and Tailwind CSS to match the existing design system. Add features like message history, typing indicators, and proper responsive design. Ensure the chat is only accessible to authenticated users by redirecting to sign-in if not logged in.
test_strategy: Test chat component rendering and interaction with mocked API responses. Verify streaming functionality works correctly. Test authentication redirect logic. Ensure responsive design works across different screen sizes.

title: Enhance Dashboard with Data Fetching
description: Modify the dashboard page to fetch and display user-specific schedule data
details: Update app/dashboard/page.tsx to implement server-side data fetching using Drizzle ORM. Query the events table for the authenticated user's schedule data, filtering by date ranges as needed. Implement proper error handling and loading states. Structure the data appropriately for the calendar and metrics components. Ensure the page is properly protected and only shows data for the authenticated user. Add pagination or date range filtering for performance with large datasets.
test_strategy: Test data fetching logic with various user scenarios (no events, many events, different date ranges). Verify user isolation - users can only see their own data. Test error handling for database connection issues.

title: Build Calendar and Metrics Dashboard Components
description: Create interactive calendar view and metrics visualization components for the dashboard
details: Create components/dashboard/CalendarView.tsx that wraps the existing shadcn/ui calendar component to display user events. Implement event rendering with proper time slots, color coding by event type, and hover tooltips. Create components/dashboard/MetricsChart.tsx using the existing chart components to visualize time allocation metrics like meeting density, free time ratio, and focus blocks. Add summary cards showing key statistics (total meetings, hours scheduled, productivity insights). Ensure all components are responsive and follow the existing design system. Integrate these components into the dashboard page layout.
test_strategy: Test calendar component with various event scenarios (overlapping events, all-day events, different types). Verify metrics calculations are accurate. Test responsive design and component interactions. Ensure proper data flow from parent dashboard page.
